events.verdict: Bullock (DET) commits a take foul on Harden (HOU).
Griffin (DET) has a hand to the opposite side waist of Tucker (HOU) but the contact is tactile in nature and he immediately slides his hand off.
Drummond (DET) makes incidental contact with Tucker's (HOU) arm after the release of his shot near the rim but does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Tucker (HOU) cleanly dislodges the ball on the rebound attempt by Drummond (DET).
Drummond (DET) makes contact with the ball while it is still in the imaginary cylinder above the basket ring.
Harden (HOU) makes contact with Jackson's (DET) body while moving laterally into his path and affects his driving shot attempt.
Harden (HOU) is in the path of Jackson (DET) when he absorbs the contact on his legal pick.
Jackson (DET) engages with Harden (HOU) but does not affect his FOM.
Jackson (DET) moves laterally into Harden's (HOU) path during his drive and affects his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Brown (DET) and Harden (HOU) enter the lane before the release of the free throw.
Bullock (DET) makes marginal contact to the arm of Harden (HOU) after he controls the rebound. The contact does not dislodge Harden or the ball.
Brown (DET) has his foot planted and he does not intentionally kick the ball on the dribble by Harden (HOU).
Harden (HOU) makes contact with Brown's (DET) arm and affects his driving shot attempt.
Tucker (HOU) is in the path of Brown (DET) when he absorbs the contact from his legal pick.
Griffin (DET) legally contests Harden's (HOU) jump shot.
Drummond (DET) is in a stationary legal screening position when he absorbs the contact from Ennis III (HOU).
Capela (HOU) is in a legal guarding position when he absorbs the contact from Griffin (DET) at the start of his drive.
Capela (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position on Griffin's (DET) jump shot.
Galloway (DET) engages and immediately disengages with Harden (HOU) and does not affect his FOM.
Galloway (DET) briefly has two hands on Ennis III's (HOU) back but he does not steer him and he allows him to move freely to set his intended screen.
Grffin (DET) is in a legal guarding position when Harden (HOU) briefly engages with him.
Ennis III (HOU) is in the path of Griffin (DET) when he absorbs the contact on his screen.
Ennis III (HOU) is in the path of Bullock (DET) when he absorbs the contact on his screen.
Tucker (HOU) makes contact with Brown (DET) in the post on his seal but does not affect his ability to contest the shot.
Brown (DET) maintains a legal guarding position on Gordon's (HOU) shot.
Griffin (DET) initiates the engagement with Tucker (HOU) and Capela (HOU) on his cut to the baseline but does not dislodge them.
Bullock (DET) is firming up in a screening position in Tucker's (HOU) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
Tucker (HOU) briefly grasps Griffin (DET) but does not affect his FOM.
Capela (HOU) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Griffin (DET) is firming up in a legal picking position in Harden's (HOU) path when contact occurs and he absorbs contact.
RAR shows Tucker (HOU) is not in a legal guarding position when he makes contact with Jackson's (DET) arm during his shooting motion on his jump shot.
Tucker (HOU) collapses his arms to his body as he firms up in a picking position in Jackson's (DET) path and he absorbs contact.
Brown (DET) is in a legal guarding position and does not take away Harden's (HOU) landing area on the jump shot attempt.
Jackson (DET) maintains his pivot foot.
LLB shows Paul (HOU) makes marginal contact with Jackson (DET) in the backcourt that does not affect his SQBR.
Tucker (HOU) makes marginal contact with Jackson (DET) on-ball.
Griffin (DET) sets the pick in Harden's (HOU) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Tucker (HOU) makes incidental contact with Jackson's (DET) arm during the follow-through on his shot near the rim.
Jackson (DET) initiates contact to Capela (HOU), who is in a legal screening position, but does not affect his FOM.
Smith (DET) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Harden's (HOU) hand after he has released the ball.
Drummond (DET) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Gordon (HOU) makes marginal contact with Jackson (DET) at the start of his drive that does not affect his SQBR.
Paul (HOU) initiates brief contact with Bullock (DET) at the start of his drive, but contact is marginal and does not affect his ability to defend.
Paul (HOU) commits a take foul on Jackson (DET).
Brown (DET) maintains a legal guarding position on Paul's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
